definitions.switch: A later arrival in the same series with a changed signed reference. Enter and exit partition it.
definitions.stable: A later arrival with the previous signed reference. All arrivals also include every first packet.
definitions.errors: Unknown always fails. Raised missed side includes called-flat, wrong-side and unknown. Correct side outside the tolerance is a separate magnitude failure. A flat false positive is an available estimate outside the inclusive flat band.
definitions.unit: One paired comparison per rendered packet view. Layouts and visibility share native motion.
